title.en: A Reinforced concrete map of the printed Concrete Pump Delivery Hose line
title.zh: 用《配筋混凝土》给已印的混凝土泵输送胶管画一张目录

description.en: Concrete Pump Delivery Hose is restated under Reinforced concrete. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai publishes Concrete Pump Delivery Hose. The published table prints Part type Concrete pump delivery / placing hose; Ends Steel couplings, factory-protected for transport; Diameter / length Quoted after confirming the pump model; Packing Project quantities from factory stock. Not printed, so left blank: cylinder bore, piston stroke, service life, a material grade number. The content photograph does not add a figure that the table omits.
description.zh: 混凝土泵输送胶管放在《配筋混凝土》的结构下重述。邢台河北品锦机械公布混凝土泵输送胶管。已公布参数表印有：配件类型混凝土泵输送 / 布料胶管；接头金属接头，出厂防护包装；管径 / 长度对照泵型号后确认报价；包装工厂备货，按工程量包装。没有印出、因此留空的栏目：缸径、活塞行程、使用寿命、材料牌号。内容照片不会补上参数表没有的数字。

body.en: Where the source outline says “Use in construction”, the catalogue fragment below is the fragment a buyer is allowed to copy. The photograph on this page is a content image downloaded from the crawled source page. It is not a Pinjin catalogue sheet. A diameter, output, distance or material grade is used here only when the Xingtai table prints it. Figures that are not readable on the photograph stay blank. Another manufacturer's rating is not written onto this Pinjin model or part. Not printed, so left blank: cylinder bore, piston stroke, service life, a material grade number. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai through the contact page. Name Concrete Pump Delivery Hose, , and the quantity (the unit printed on the page). Confirm the size on the machine. The wear-part page does not print a list price and does not sell the spare as a small parcel. These are Xingtai replacement parts, not OEM parts of another pump brand. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
